title: 974. Broken Calculator

examples.explanation: Double to 6, subtract to 5, double to 10.

hints: Going forward, doubling overshoots while subtracting crawls; think backwards from target instead.
Reversed, the moves are halve (when even) and add one: an odd target must first be bumped up to become even.
Once target drops to startValue or below, the rest is plain subtraction.
